metadata.title: Analysis code and derived outputs for cross-cohort calibration of pretreatment mucosal modules in inflammatory bowel disease
metadata.description: Version 2.0.0 contains code, documentation and derived outputs for dataset-independence auditing, unified published-signature benchmarking, leave-one-cohort-out and stratified meta-analysis, GSE92415 clinical-increment modelling, TAURUS-referenced partial deconvolution and vedolizumab/ustekinumab treatment-boundary analysis. Public raw archives and manuscript submission files are not included.
